confirm.deactivateDesc: {name} will lose access to the entire platform until reactivated.

confirm.bulkRestoreDesc: Deleted accounts come back with the access they had. Anyone in the selection who is not deleted is skipped.

bulkBranch.desc: Put the selected people in a branch, or turn their access there on or off.
